owner_instruction_excerpt: Allow external gates (Recommended). Fix the Project Truth ledger digest so it no longer depends on git's clone-size-dependent abbreviation length; new rows hash full blob ids and legacy rows match any abbreviation git could have used. Map the six CORE manifest items (rt.antigravity, prov.xkiro, prov.google-antigravity, prov.google-stitch, cred.xkiro, cred.stitch) to the checks that already certify them. The Netcup cutover may leave open items that carry a named external or auth gate (EXTERNAL-GATE-*, AUTH-GATE-*), such as Cloudflare Access and Google provider integration; they stay tracked, anything that FAILs still blocks, and post-activation certification still reports them.
